before_execution: confirm repository is clean at the proposal commit
confirm reviewed PDF and research-state fingerprint are current
confirm a distinct exact one-use data-audit approval exists and is unexpired
confirm the approval binds every proposal object hash and only stages 1, 2 and 3
confirm no market-research approval is being substituted
confirm implementation and synthetic safety tests have been separately reviewed
confirm output and temporary directories are outside the database directory
during_execution: consume approval before first database connection
record every attempted statement before execution
recheck identity and sidecars at every checkpoint
abort on any mismatch, deadline, write attempt or scope expansion
after_execution: perform final identity and sidecar check
write terminal status and content hashes
verify outputs contain no resolved paths, credentials or market observations
do not infer historical completeness, point-in-time fitness or research eligibility
